stories.headline: NJ bank's losses to mushroom as loan cleanup accelerates
stories.body: BCB Bancorp says red ink may top $130 million in the third quarter, as its new CEO moves to address credit-quality issues.

stories.headline: ISO 42001 May Become a Payments AI Governance Benchmark
stories.body: Payments firms need a way to identify where artificial intelligence is being used and who’s responsible for it, as well as to monitor how those systems are managed over time. stories.headline: ‘It's awful’: How tariffs, soaring fuel costs and higher interest rates are squeezing American companies
stories.body: Tariffs, fuel prices and interest rates are squeezing American companies, particularly manufacturers, auto suppliers, retailers and transportation businesses.
